analyst.summary: Network18 is the Reliance-controlled media company behind CNBC-TV18, News18, and related TV-news and digital properties. A large part of the group's entertainment business was folded into a separate joint venture (JioStar) with Disney over the past two years, which makes the reported multi-year revenue decline look much larger than the actual change in the remaining TV-news-and-digital business, which is growing modestly and gaining advertising share even as the broader TV news ad market shrinks. That said, the company as it stands today is still not profitable, and its earnings do not cover its interest costs, so caution remains warranted.
